title: Mom gave him one week to win back $2,000
description: Mom finds Nate blew his $2,000 savings on coins with three dollars to show for it and gives him one week to make every dollar back; after a night alone he trades his way up on fomo, Mom grabs a phone and joins him, and they hit a six-figure balance together. The reselling becomes trading on fomo, the live-action tag becomes Nate's fomo line. Unlike the other two, Nate hits his low point alone ('I can't let her down') before any grind, and it ends on Mom screaming at a closet full of new screens.
text:
SCENE 1 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — DAY
The bedroom door flies open; Mom storms in shaking Nate's empty wallet.
MOM: Nate! Where is all your money?
Nate, tiny at his desk in the far corner, turns round in his chair.
NATE: What?
Mom slams the wallet on the desk and leans into his face.
MOM: You had $2,000.
Nate spins his chair to face her, arms out.
NATE: I spent it.
MOM: On what?
NATE: My business.
Whip-pan across his set-up: the phone on a stand, the old laptop, chart sketches taped all over the wall.
MOM: You spent $2,000 on coins?
Nate grabs his phone and pushes it at her.
NATE: They're not just coins.
MOM: How much have you made?
Nate checks his phone and holds it to the lens.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone held to the lens, the position reads +$3.00
NATE: Actually, I just started.
Extreme close-up on Mom: saucer eyes, then a gritted-teeth snarl.
MOM: Three?
NATE: Yes.
Mom throws her arms up and slams her hand on the wallet.
MOM: You spent $2,000!
NATE: I'm gonna make it back.
MOM: Then prove it.
NATE: How?
MOM: One week.
NATE: For what?
MOM: Make your $2,000 back.
NATE: All of it?
Nose to nose in profile, neither blinks.
MOM: Every dollar.
NATE: Fine.
SCENE 2 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
Nate alone at the desk in the dark, his face lit blue by the phone.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, the line sliding red, the position still stuck at +$3.00
Nate drops his head onto his arms.
NATE: I can't let her down.
He sits up and pulls the phone close.
NATE: One more time.
SCENE 3 — MONTAGE — NATE'S BEDROOM — NIGHTS
Nate's hands fly over the old laptop keys, his face lit blue, cold noodles beside him.
A red day: Nate rubs his eyes, shakes it off and leans back in.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, a small first win: the position reads +$42
Nate's tired eyes flicker; a tiny fist pump, then straight back to the phone.
Locked-off on the desk: the wall clock behind Nate races through the night while he never leaves the chair.
Sunrise floods the window behind him; Nate is still at it, sticky notes piling up on the wall.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, a bigger win: the balance reads $1,240
Night again, the clock spinning; Nate hunched over the phone, chart sketches climbing to the ceiling.
SCENE 4 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
Nate stares at the phone and rises slowly from the chair, eyes and mouth wide.
NATE: Wait, wait, wait.
Extreme close-up on one eye, slow push in.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $3,300
NATE: Three, three...
Nate grips the phone, the glow on his face.
NATE: Mom!
He runs to the doorway where Mom stands and shoves the phone at her.
MOM: What?
NATE: Look!
MOM: What am I looking at?
NATE: Wins!
MOM: How many?
SCENE 5 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — DAY
Wide on Nate at his desk in daylight: with each count his set-up grows around him, a second phone stand, a new chair, a ring light.
NATE (V.O.): 10... 20... 30.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $15,200
At the kitchen table Nate taps two phones at once in fast motion; Mom watches, stunned.
NATE: Wait, they're still coming!
MOM: Right now?
Nate fumbles one phone; Mom snatches it out of his hand.
MOM: Give me that.
NATE: What?
MOM: You're too slow.
Medium close-up on Nate: wide eyes, then a huge open grin.
NATE: Wait... OK!
SCENE 6 — MONTAGE — THE KITCHEN TABLE — DAYS AND NIGHTS
The same frontal two-shot of Mom and Nate side by side at the table, each on a phone, as match cuts swap the world behind them: warm kitchen, blue night, sunny yard with palm trees, warm brick wall.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Mom's phone, the balance reads $31,500
Mom kisses Nate's cheek without looking up from her phone.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $58,900
NATE: More!
MOM: Keep trading!
NATE: I am!
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $87,300
SCENE 7 — INT. LIVING ROOM — DAY
Nate and Mom drop onto the sofa, the phone held between them.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $412,600
NATE: We did it.
MOM: You did.
NATE: No.
NATE: We did.
They turn and walk to the hall closet; the door swings open on a wall of brand-new monitors.
★ fomo screen: Desktop trading — on the wall of monitors filling the closet
MOM: Nate... Nate... more screens?
Whip to Mom's extreme close-up: a huge comic scream.
Nate turns to camera with a small smirk, phone up.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $412,600
NATE: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.

Mid-40s, warm light-brown skin, brown chin-length bob, big expressive brows; beige button-up blouse, navy trousers, small gold hoop earrings. Plays big: furrowed brows, saucer eyes, a screaming close-up.
